Container.Name: Floe-Client
Container.Overview: Web client for Floe encrypted peer-to-peer file transfer. Install Floe-Server first, then set that server template's Client URL to this app's exact browser origin.[br][br]Set Signaling Server URL to the full Floe-Server origin that browsers reach, including the scheme and the host port, for example http://192.168.1.10:3001. Leave it empty only when both containers sit behind one domain.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used to open the Floe web client.

Config.Name: Signaling Server URL
Config.Description: Full origin of Floe-Server as browsers reach it, including the scheme and the host port, and with no trailing slash. For example http://192.168.1.10:3001 or https://floe-api.example.com. Leave this empty only when the client and the signaling server share one domain behind a reverse proxy, in which case the browser uses the origin it loaded from.
